heading: Today
text: Sun giving way to periods of clouds, then thinning later this afternoon.  Not as cold.  Highs warming to the upper 40s and low 50s north, the mid to upper 50s south.  Winds light, mainly south less than 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Partly cloudy through the evening, then clearing.  Not so chilly.  Lows in the 30s, cool spots near 30.  Winds light and variable east, turning to the south from the Green Mountains west 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph through the Champlain Valley and over the higher terrain.

heading: Thursday
text: Mostly sunny, with some clouds arriving late in the St. Lawrence Valley.  Warmer.  Highs ranging through the 60s.  Light winds, becoming south to southwest near 10 mph east, and 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph from the Green Mountains west.
